pages.text: [#](53341a)The Boline is the witch's field knife. It behaves much like shears, but it also harvests cobweb intact and safely gathers Blood Poppies and other delicate ingredients that rough hands would ruin.[#]()
pages.title: The Boline

pages.text: [#](53341a)Forge it from iron, bone, and an emerald. It fights no better than a wooden sword, but it endures like iron and matters far more as a tool.[#]()
